verses.1: Those who walk in the ways of Jehovah’s law.
verses.2: May their followers truly seek him with all their hearts.
verses.3: They did not even act in their own ways. They walked along their own paths.
verses.4: You have commanded your officials to keep many things safe.
verses.5: May they guide me in keeping with your laws.
verses.6: So, I do not disobey any of your commandments.
verses.7: I teach you in the midst of difficulties, so that you may understand your laws of justice.
verses.8: I will keep your commandments. Do not leave me until the end.
verses.9: In what way will the young man be able to keep his word as you have commanded?
verses.10: With all my heart, I ask you to do not violate your commandments.
verses.11: In my heart, I have remembered your words, so that I may not sin against you.
verses.12: Blessed are you, Yahweh, who teach me your laws.
verses.13: In my words, I have recounted all your judgments.
verses.14: In the way of your testimony, I have wept like all those who are mourners.
verses.15: In your houses, I will provide food and drink for your guests.
verses.16: In your laws, I will never forget your words.
verses.17: May your servants live and keep your words.
verses.18: My eyes and my heart are filled with joy from your words.
verses.19: I will dwell in this land; do not hide from me your commandments.
verses.20: I am willing to submit my soul to your judgment at any time.
verses.21: You have caused great suffering to those who are obedient to your commands.
verses.22: May shame and disgrace be upon me, for your testimonies have been destroyed.
verses.23: And also, priests shall sit in my place. My servants will serve you according to your laws.
verses.24: Also, your testimonies are the ways in which my people live.
verses.25: My soul is deeply connected to the sun; it lives because of your words.
verses.26: I have told you my ways; please enlighten me with your laws.
verses.27: By your commands, I will understand and obey them.
verses.28: My soul is filled with sorrow; may you keep me alive, as you say.
verses.29: The false path is removed from me; may your law protect me.
verses.30: I have chosen the path of truth from your judgments.
verses.31: I have clung to your promises, O LORD; do not disdain me.
verses.32: The way of your commandments is a land that expands my heart.
verses.33: May the LORD guide me along the paths of righteousness and in His ways.
verses.34: Please understand me, and I will keep your teachings in my heart.
verses.35: Guide me in accordance with your commandments, for that is what I desire.
verses.36: My heart is with you, and not with those who are enemies of you.
verses.37: Let my eyes be freed from seeing those who are evil along your path. May I live in peace.
verses.38: I will serve your word, because of your commandment.
verses.39: I have endured humiliation because your judgments are righteous.
verses.40: Now, I will judge you according to your righteousness, O my God.
verses.41: May your mercy be upon me, O LORD; may your salvation come as you say.
verses.42: And I will answer your words with harshness, for I trust in your words.
verses.43: And do not speak false words in my place, for I am subject to your judgment.
verses.44: And I will always keep your Torah forever and ever.
verses.45: And you went forth into the wide field, for I had commanded you to do so.
verses.46: And I will speak on your behalf against kings, and not for them.
verses.47: And I will obey your commandments, which I have loved.
verses.48: And I will lay my hands on your commandments that I have loved, and I will follow them according to your laws.
verses.49: A reminder to serve you, for what you have given me.
verses.50: This is my comfort in my troubles, for your words have given me life.
verses.51: I have never strayed from your teachings, O Lord! I have always followed your commands.
verses.52: I remember your judgments from forever, O LORD; and I acknowledge them.
verses.53: Zelahafa, you hold me captive among the wicked who abandon your laws.
verses.54: My songs were like laws in my humble home.
verses.55: I remembered in the night that your name is Jehovah, and I will keep your commandments.
verses.56: This happened to me because you were taken captive.
verses.57: The parts of Jehovah said I must keep your words.
verses.58: I have poured out my heart before you, O Lord, as you commanded me.
verses.59: I considered my ways, and I set my feet toward your commands.
verses.60: I felt, but I did not dare to obey your commandments.
verses.61: The ropes of the wicked have bound me; your law has not been forgotten by me.
verses.62: Half of the night, I will rise to pray for you, for your righteous judgments.
verses.63: I am allied with all those who fear you and who obey your commands.
verses.64: Your kindness, LORD, fills the earth; your laws guide me.
verses.65: You have done well with your servant Jehovah, as you commanded.
verses.66: May wisdom and knowledge guide me, so that I may obey your commandments.
verses.67: Before I can answer, I’m confused. Now, I’ll keep your words in mind.
verses.68: Good are you, and it is beneficial for me to learn your laws.
verses.69: I have suffered greatly because of your false accusations. I do this wholeheartedly, in order to get rid of your evil plans.
verses.70: I am your word, O Lord; I am your revelation.
verses.71: It is good for me that I have answered, so that I may remember your laws.
verses.72: May your Torah be better than all the gold and silver in the world.
verses.73: You have created me, and you have shaped me. Please understand me, and I will learn your commandments.
verses.74: May they fear me and rejoice, for by your word I have been freed.
verses.75: I know that Jehovah is righteous in your judgments, and that you are truthful in your decisions.
verses.76: May your kindness be with me, as you said to your servant.
verses.77: May your mercy come to me, and I may live, because your Torah is beneficial to me.
verses.78: They will be punished for their lies. I will punish them according to your laws.
verses.79: May your fears return to me, and may I understand your secrets.
verses.80: May my heart be pure in your laws, so that I may not sin.
verses.81: May my soul be restored to your healing, O Lord! May I be healed by your words.
verses.82: My eyes are filled with tears for your words, “May you be comforted.”
verses.83: Since I was a prisoner in Kitor, you still remember me. I haven’t forgotten you at all.
verses.84: How many days will it take for your servant to be punished by judgment?
verses.85: Give me words that are not in your writing.
verses.86: All your commandments are true. The false ones have tried to deceive me, but they failed. Help me!
verses.87: Even though I have been scattered across this land, I have not abandoned your traditions.
verses.88: By your grace, I shall live, and I will honor your laws.
verses.89: For ever, the word of the LORD shall be established in heaven.
verses.90: From generation to generation, your promises remain true; you create the earth and it remains stable.
verses.91: Today, you stood before your judgment. For everything has become your servant.
verses.92: If your law were to be fulfilled, then I would be destroyed in my troubles.
verses.93: I will never forget your commands, for in them you have given me life.
verses.94: I will save you, for your commands I have taken upon myself.
verses.95: May the wicked destroy my treasures! May they take away your blessings from me.
verses.96: In every situation, I have seen the broad scope of your commandments.
verses.97: What have I loved about your Torah all these days? It’s your teachings that I love most.
verses.98: May my Lord guide me according to your commandments, for they are eternal for me.
verses.99: From all my teachings, I have learned that your words are true.
verses.100: I have built them up, for your commands have been fulfilled.
verses.101: From all evil places, I will take my feet, so that I may keep your words.
verses.102: From your judgments, I have not sinned, for you are my Savior.
verses.103: What must I wait for your words from the depths of the earth?
verses.104: According to your commands, I built it. Thus, I loved every wrongful person.
verses.105: A lamp for my feet along your path, and light for my way.
verses.106: I will obey and keep your laws.
verses.107: I answer with great willingness, O LORD my God, as you command me.
verses.108: May the Lord give me wisdom and your laws, so that I may understand them.
verses.109: My heart is always with you, and I have never forgotten your Torah.
verses.110: The wicked have given me poverty, and from your judgments I will not be able to escape.
verses.111: I have given you my inheritance forever, for my heart is filled with joy.
verses.112: I have decided to follow these laws forever.
verses.113: I love your laws and your commandments.
verses.114: Your secrets and mysteries are known to you; I shall speak of them.
verses.115: May those who are evil and those who oppose my commands be destroyed.
verses.116: Let me be saved as you say, and I will live. Do not disgrace me with my sins.
verses.117: Help me, and be merciful to me. Please be just in your laws always.
verses.118: We have destroyed all those who were false and deceitful.
verses.119: May all the sins of the earth be destroyed! For I have loved your virtues.
verses.120: I fear your words and your judgments.
verses.121: I have done what is just and fair. I will not allow them to harm me.
verses.122: May your servant do good to me, and may he not harm me.
verses.123: My eyes are filled with joy for your salvation and for your righteous words.
verses.124: Do to your servants as you are merciful and righteous, so that I may learn from you.
verses.125: O my servant, please understand me and let me know your true intentions.
verses.126: It is time to carry out Jehovah’s commands.
verses.127: Therefore, I loved your commandments like gold and silver.
verses.128: Therefore, all the decrees and regulations of my laws apply to every wrongdoer who has ever come before me.
verses.129: For your wickedness, they were punished; my soul was destroyed because of it.
verses.130: May your words be made clear to those who understand.
verses.131: I have wept and cried, for I have obeyed your commandments.
verses.132: Turn your face away from me, and treat me as if I were a sinner among those who love you.
verses.133: Sometimes, in your words, you say that you won’t control me. But don’t try to do that.
verses.134: I am freed from the bondage of man, and I will keep your commands.
verses.135: Your face shall shine upon your servant, and teach me your laws.
verses.136: The tears of water fell from my eyes, because they did not keep your commandments.
verses.137: You are righteous, O LORD, and your judgments are just.
verses.138: I have commanded justice to be your witness, and truth to be your constant companion.
verses.139: Give me my jealousy, for they have forgotten your words.
verses.140: Your words are wonderful, and your servant loves them.
verses.141: I am young, and I remember your words clearly. I have not forgotten them.
verses.142: Your righteousness is true forever, and your law is true.
verses.143: The wicked have found my commandments to be meaningless.
verses.144: Justice is your witness forever. Please help me understand and be my friend.
verses.145: I have called out to You with all my heart, O LORD; please hear my prayer.
verses.146: I beg you to save me, and to keep my promises.
verses.147: I stand before you, and I will obey your words.
verses.148: My eyes are fixed upon your words.
verses.149: Let my voice be heard as your mercy, O LORD, as your judgment. May I live!
verses.150: Go away, you followers of Zimah! Stay far away from your teachings.
verses.151: You are near, O LORD, and all your commandments are true.
verses.152: Long ago, I knew from your signs that you would establish them forever.
verses.153: Look at my suffering and rescue me, for your covenant I have not forgotten.
verses.154: Let me be saved from my conflicts, according to your word. May I live!
verses.155: Far from the wicked, there is salvation; for your laws they have not obeyed.
verses.156: Your mercy is great, O LORD, as your judgments. May it be a blessing to me.
verses.157: Many of my enemies and adversaries are from your own land; yet I have not turned against them.
verses.158: I saw garments and decorations that you said should not be kept.
verses.159: See that you love your Lord as I have loved You, O God, for Your kindness gives me life.
verses.160: Your words are true, and forever, all your judgments are righteous.
verses.161: The lions chased me, and your words filled my heart with fear.
verses.162: I am satisfied with your words, as if I have found a great treasure.
verses.163: I have loved the false things; I will despise your laws. I have loved them instead.
verses.164: Seven days I will praise your judgments, for they are righteous.
verses.165: Great is the peace for those who love Your Torah, and there is no end to it.
verses.166: I have obeyed your commands, O LORD, and I have carried out your laws.
verses.167: My soul has preserved your commandments, and I love them deeply.
verses.168: I have kept your commandments and laws, for all my ways are directed towards you.
verses.169: May my prayers come before you, LORD, as you have commanded me. Please understand me.
verses.170: My tent will be opened before you, as you have said, “Save me.”
verses.171: My lips will sing praises to You, because You teach me Your laws.
verses.172: Answer my words, for all your commandments are just.
verses.173: May your hand be with me, so that I may be able to help you, for your commands are the ones I have chosen.
verses.174: I long for your salvation, LORD, and for your Torah.
verses.175: May my soul live and praise you; may your justice help me.
verses.176: I have obeyed when you commanded me to serve you, for I have not forgotten your commandments.
